blind.B1: No. The series (GSE221003) is a doxorubicin cardiotoxicity / NMN study; no sequenced group is exercised or trained. Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion and rotarod TEST on chronic cohort-2 and cohort-3 (S2.5.p1, S2.6.p1, S3.7.p1), a phenotype outcome. Acute RNA-seq is on cohort-1 hearts (S2.2.p2). No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: Acute, D5 hearts: Doxo vs Ctrl and Doxo-NMN vs Doxo (S3.3.p1). Cohort-1 RNA-seq on 13-14 hearts per group (S2.2.p2); GEO has 14 Vehicle / 13 Doxo / 13 Doxo-NMN.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one heart per mouse, one tissue, one time point. The 'suffix of title' key in packet A is only the replicate index rep1..repN, and the expression check says not_supported (p=0.32). No animal ID is documented or needed.
blind.B4: S2.9.p1: edgeR, TMM, estimateDisp, negative-binomial GLM, QL F-test; the paper speaks of 'pairwise comparison' (S3.3.p1) but does not say whether it was a joint or separate fit.
blind.B5: S3.3.p1: 'Pairwise comparison between Doxo vs. Ctrl mice and Doxo-NMN vs. Doxo mice identified 3874 and 2207 differentially expressed genes (adjusted p-value < 0.05 and FC cutoff of 1.5), respectively.' Inclusive or strict is not stated.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm among sequenced hearts (S2.2.p2, S2.2.p4; metadata treatment = Vehicle/Doxo/Doxo-NMN; packet A finds no exercise words in any column). Refusal is correct.
Aligned levels 14/13/13 match the paper's 13-14 per group; no exclusions. Not exercised as no contrast was run.
One heart per mouse. The title-suffix candidate is a replicate index; pairing_check not_supported (r diff 0.03, p=0.32). repeated_measure_unit = none is right.
No fit run; the paper is silent on joint versus pairwise.
No contrast run. Acute and chronic cohorts were sequenced at different providers (S2.9.p1) but are separate matrices here.
Integer fraction 1.0, featureCounts, so raw counts; recommended edgeR matches S2.9.p1.
FDR 0.05 and FC 1.5 (log2 0.585) transcribed correctly from S3.3.p1.
HANDBACK lists the paper counts (3874 / 2207) only as reference and claims no comparison.

'No exercise arm' is true and was checked against the paper and metadata, not only a narrow key. The suitability fail 'sample_size 0/0 comparisons' is a mechanical artefact of having no contrast, not a true sample-size problem; groups have >=13 each.
checks.fix: Optional: state in the record that the sample_size fail is a consequence of the refusal, not a finding.

human_items: Open policy question (not an error): whether a drug-contrast dataset from a paper with an exercise test outcome should ever be run as a sensitivity analysis; skill rule says no exercise arm means refuse.
summary: 该系列(GSE221003 急性组)是阿霉素心脏毒性与 NMN 研究,测序的心脏样本只有 Ctrl/Doxo/Doxo-NMN,没有运动干预;跑步机只是未测序队列的表型检测,拒绝分析的理由成立。其余检查项(分组、阈值、矩阵类型、无重复测量)与论文一致,仅有一个次要的措辞问题(sample_size 失败只是拒绝的机械后果)。
